note: global batch fixed: gradient accumulation absorbs the change
DDP gradient all-reduce on every micro-batch (on) vs no_sync until the accumulation boundary (off)

text: DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 256) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): latent_cache off->on x1.50 (HDX01->HDX05); precision fp32->bf16 x1.40 (HDX00->HDX01); compile off->on x1.32 (HDX05->HDX06); micro_batch 32->16 x0.84 (HDX05->HDX40); grad_sync_every_micro off->on x0.95 (HDX40->HDX42); optimizer adamw->adamw_fused x1.05 (HDX05->HDX07); ema loop->off x1.05 (HDX05->HDX09). Fastest measured: HDX30 0.08797 s/update (x3.10 vs HDX00), 29.18 GiB peak.

sd15-unet full (diffusers, 512 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 128) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): precision bf16->fp32 x0.37 (HSA00->HSA02); compile off->on x1.18 (HSA00->HSA22); recompute none->full x0.87 (HSA00->HSA04). Fastest measured: HSA22 0.2998 s/update (x1.18 vs HSA00), 29.25 GiB peak.

sdxl-unet full (diffusers, 1024 px, 16384 latent tokens, global batch 32) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): compile off->on x1.29 (HSX00->HSX21); recompute full->none x1.28 (HSX00->HSX01). Fastest measured: HSX21 0.4325 s/update (x1.29 vs HSX00), 61.5 GiB peak.
DiT-S/2 full (dit, 256 px, 256 latent tokens, global batch 256) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Fastest measured: HDS30 0.02068 s/update (x4.64 vs HDS00), 4.19 GiB peak.

flux1-dev lora-r32 (diffusers, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): recompute full->none x1.35 (HFL00->HFL01). Fastest measured: HFL01 0.6573 s/update (x1.35 vs HFL00), 61.56 GiB peak.

wan2.1-t2v-1.3b full (diffsynth, 832x480 px, 81 frames, 32760 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): attention_backend flash->auto x0.96 (HWN00->HWN01). Fastest measured: HWN00 5.654 s/update, 34.22 GiB peak.

flux1-dev full (diffusers, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): zero_stage 3->2 x1.58 (HFF00->HFF01); recompute full->none x1.34 (HFF00->HFF06). Fastest measured: HFF01 1.099 s/update (x1.58 vs HFF00), 77.43 GiB peak.

DiT-XL/2 full (dit, 512 px, 1024 latent tokens, global batch 256) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): precision fp32->bf16 x1.98 (HD500->HD501); latent_cache off->on x1.67 (HD501->HD505). Fastest measured: HD530 0.3153 s/update (x4.49 vs HD500), 58.72 GiB peak.

flux1-dev lora-r32 (diffsynth, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): recompute full->none x1.31 (HDF00->HDF05); attention_backend flash->cudnn_prio x1.12 (HDF00->HDF01). Fastest measured: HDF05 0.7658 s/update (x1.31 vs HDF00), 73.1 GiB peak.

qwen-image lora-r32 (diffusers, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): recompute full->none x1.36 (HQL00->HQL04). Fastest measured: HQL04 0.6143 s/update (x1.36 vs HQL00), 74.13 GiB peak.

qwen-image lora-r32 (diffsynth, 1024 px, 4096 latent tokens, global batch 8) on 1 x 8 H200-141GB. Single changes (speed-up = t_before / t_after): recompute full->none x1.31 (HDQ00->HDQ02). Fastest measured: HDQ02 0.7718 s/update (x1.31 vs HDQ00), 103.75 GiB peak.
